author: BBC Earth
description:
JADE joins forces with legendary composer Hans Zimmer for the original title track of Blue Planet III.
 
Sir David Attenborough returns to take us deeper into our oceans than ever before, revealing extraordinary new stories from beneath the waves.

Main Theme
Hans Zimmer and Thom Lukas for Bleeding Fingers Music

Original Music
Hans Zimmer and Thom Lukas and Laurentina Editha for Bleeding Fingers Music. Featuring Victoria Canal

Additional Music
Ho-Ling Tang

“Seas Cry”
 Hans Zimmer and Thom Lukas for Bleeding Fingers Music
 Featuring JADE
 Lyrics by Jade Thirwall, Pablo Bowman and Fin Dow-Smith

Score Producer
Russell Emanuel
